details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 1 - The Recruits · Seat 3, Healer

A red-haired wood elf in a crown of antlers and leaves, never far from Bramble, the bad-tempered boar who adopted her. Warm, blunt and fiercely protective; she patches up anyone who stands still long enough, then tells them off for getting hurt. She trained with the Nalwood circle, and joined the Keepers because hurt people rarely come to the forest.

Tonight: If anyone down there is hurt, goblin or not, she means to bring them out.

In a fight

Keep everyone standing with Cure Light Wounds and First Aid. Open with Faerie Fire on a crowd so the others hit with Advantage, Thunderwave anything that gets too close, and let Bramble charge.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Spell Use. Nature caster, Wisdom-based, save DC 13. Three cantrips at will. Two 1st-level slots a day (1, +1 for Wisdom 13+), back after a long rest. Each morning prepare three spells (level 1 + Wisdom +2) from the whole Druid list. Her oak staff is her focus.

Wild Shape. Once a day, become a beast of Level 1 or lower (a boar like Bramble) for up to an hour, using its whole stat block. You keep your mind and cannot cast in a form that cannot speak; when the form drops to 0 HP you return with the HP you had.

Nature Lore (Wisdom). In your home region, identify plants and animals perfectly, tell whether water is safe, and find shelter and food for one person; elsewhere it needs a Wisdom check.

Bonus Language. You speak Druidic, the circle's secret tongue.

Forest Vigour (kit). Healing you cast restores +1 HP per die.

Ancient Lore (kit). Advantage on Nature Lore checks in old-growth forest.

Healer (1st, Arcane & Devout). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die, and once a day you cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without a slot.

Bramble. A wild boar she befriended with Animal Friendship. She renews it each evening before she rests, so it costs no slot on the day; harm him and the friendship ends. He follows her and the GM runs him: Level 1, AC 16, 9 HP, speed 40ft, Tusk +4 (1d8+2), Charge (+1d8 and Fortitude DC 12 or Prone after a 20ft straight run), Relentless once a day.

Elf (Saevren). Speed 35ft, low-light vision. Immune to magical sleep. Advantage on saves against charm, on concentration saves, and on Perception by sight or hearing; Advantage on Stealth and Perception in natural surroundings. Trance: 4 hours' rest instead of 8.

Camouflage. Once a day, as part of your movement in natural terrain, become undetectable to passive notice until you move or act.

No forged metal. Her weapons and armour are wood, leather and stone, as a druid's must be.

Casting

First Aid (cantrip): touch, a dying creature is stabilised at its current HP with no roll; it stays unconscious until healed or for 1 hour.

Thorn Whip (cantrip): 30ft, one creature takes 1d4 piercing and is pulled 10ft towards you; Reflex negates both.

Poison Spray (cantrip): 10ft, one creature takes 1d6 poison; Fortitude negates.

Cure Light Wounds (1st): touch, heals 1d8+3 (+1 for level, +1 Forest Vigour, +1 Healer); one free cast a day from Healer.

Faerie Fire (1st): 60ft, 20ft radius, 1 minute; creatures are outlined, lose Invisible and concealment, and attacks against them have Advantage; Reflex negates.

Thunderwave (1st): 15ft cone, 1d6 thunder and pushed 10ft; Fortitude halves the damage and stops the push. Heard 300ft away.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 4 (Cuir Bouille, Medium) + 2 (Dex, Medium max +2) = 16

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Bonus Language

  • Effect: Gain the secret druidic tongue — forbidden to teach to non-druids.
  • High Intelligence also unlocks: Elvish, Giant, Gnomish, Primordial, Sylvan

Nature Lore (Wisdom)

  • Effect: Identify plants and animals perfectly within the Druid's trained region.
  • Determine if water is safe to drink
  • Find basic shelter and enough food for one person automatically
  • Feeding additional people takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds an extra 2d4 people
  • Unfamiliar regions require a Wisdom check for all of the above

Wild Shape

  • Effect: Shapeshift into any beast or beast-like monster of Level no greater than half your Druid level, rounded down (minimum Level 1), once per day (more often as you rise in level, below), choosing the form fresh each time (any beast in Monsters & Treasure, or one of these beast-like monsters: Owlbear, Death Dog, Hippogriff, Griffon, Ankheg, Bulette, Carrion Crawler, Grick, Grick Alpha, Hook Horror, Young Remorhaz, Hydra, Piercer and Rust Monster; others at the GM's call, but never a solo, an intelligent or a magical creature).
  • Lasts up to 1 hour or until you choose to revert.
  • You take the form's whole stat block from Monsters & Treasure: its HP, AC, attacks, saves and movement.
  • You keep your own mind, personality and Wisdom-based abilities, and you cannot cast spells in a form that cannot speak.
  • When the form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form with the HP you had when you changed (see Changing Shape in Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • 3rd level: usable twice per day
  • 6th level: usable three times per day
  • 9th level: usable four times per day
  • 15th level: usable five times per day
  • 24th level: usable six times per day

2nd Level

Resist Elements

  • Effect: Advantage on saves vs fire, water, earth, air, cold, and lightning attacks.

3rd Level

Woodland Stride

  • Effect: Move through natural difficult terrain — thorns, briars, overgrowth — at full speed with no damage or impairment, leaving no trail.
  • Magically manipulated terrain still impedes normally

5th Level

Perfect Recall

  • Effect: Recall a previously cast 1st-level spell once per day via a Wisdom check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot.
  • Scales at 24th level: now works for previously cast 2nd-level spells

6th Level

Wild Shape Casting

  • Effect: While in Wild Shape, you may cast spells from your prepared list that have only verbal or no components.
  • Spells requiring somatic components cannot be cast while shifted
  • Your Wisdom modifier applies normally to all spells cast in this way

8th Level

Elemental Mastery

  • Effect: Choose one element — fire, cold, lightning, earth, water, or air. You have Resistance to its damage.

9th Level

Language of the Wilderlands

  • Effect: Communicate with the beasts native to your Nature Lore regions through their natural sounds and motions.

12th Level

Deepened Shape

  • Effect: Your Wild Shape Level cap rises to your full Druid level instead of half (so a 12th-level Druid can become any beast or monster of Level 12 or lower). Shifting also now grants temporary HP equal to twice your Druid level, lasting until the shift ends or the temp HP is depleted.

13th Level

Advanced Nature Lore

  • Effect: Nature Lore now extends to a second region or regional type, fully functional including foraging.
  • Extends to a third region at 21st level

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

18th Level

Dismiss Woodland Creatures (Wisdom)

  • Effect: Dismiss any animal, beast, plant, or vermin native to one of the Druid's Nature Lore regions.
  • Wisdom check, DC = 10 + total Levels of the creatures being dismissed
  • Each day the Druid can dismiss Levels worth of creatures equal to 10 + Wisdom modifier without penalty
  • Dismissed creatures flee and don't return until the Druid departs

20th Level

Elemental Mastery (Improved)

  • Effect: You are now immune to your chosen element's damage entirely.
  • When struck by a spell of that element, make a Wisdom check against the spell's save DC
  • Succeed on the check: the spell is reflected back at a target of the Druid's choice for its original damage

21st Level

Language of the Wilderlands (Improved)

  • Effect: You can now communicate with any bird, beast, tree, or growing thing via their natural method — sound, motion, communion.
  • Most creatures have limited understanding — expect simple impressions, not tactical reports

24th Level

Awaken Woodland Spirit

  • Effect: Spend several days with a plant or animal to fully awaken it — grants human-level consciousness, speech in the Druid's tongue, two extra HD, maximum HP, and +2 to AC, damage, and saves.
  • The awakened creature remains loyal to the Druid for life
  • Maximum awakened HD at any time = twice your Druid level

Kits: Druidic Circles

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Druid folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • Druid Kits represent which circle a Druid was trained in. The Cabal is an overarching druidic organisation with multiple regional circles, each led by a Hierophant. Mournas has its own independent circle separate from the Cabal's structure.

Druid Spell List

Spells available to the Druid, by level. * = reversible spell. ‡ = needs a costed material component (see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue). Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.

  • Bonus Spells: Wisdom 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the Druid is high enough level to cast that tier.
